replies.author: PhilosophyforOne
replies.body:
There's a pretty simple test. Fable 5.1 was trained with a cutoff around early 2026. The new version has a later cutoff. You ask the model if it knows who tibo the reset guy is, without using search tools. If it knows, it's a newer version. If not, it's the current. 

The same thing happened with Opus 5.5 a week before it was released.
